reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Gina Bianchini, founder and CEO of Mighty Networks, which gives creators a platform to start.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Gina Bianchini, founder and CEO of Mighty Networks, which gives creators a platform to start, grow and own their social communities. In our conversation, we cover the differences between leadership and management, the lessons Gina learned building a similar business in the 2000s with Marc Andreessen.

key_points.text: In our conversation, we cover the differences between leadership and management.
We talk about community design, finding ways to connect like-minded people, why it’s so important to create movement.
Please enjoy this great conversation with Gina Bianchini.
